text: Left ribbon lists the active pods and clusters, each with an indicator: waiting or working, how many agent pods run, and a circular 0-100% context gauge.
Main view is a chat with smart message loading showing agent activity: past inputs, outputs, thinking and tool calls.
The web UI theme matches the ros2-lerobot-sverve-platform web UI.
Pods and groups of pods (clusters) can be defined with their config and discarded.
A headless API orchestrates and communicates with the sessions and is the unified router for future use at scale (tatara, magic-trainer).
Messages to a cluster go round-robin: the agent that has been free the longest receives the message.
Agents in a cluster can communicate with each other.
A cluster's agents share a PVC on RWX rook-ceph CephFS.
Every new session starts with any-mcp preinstalled.
The setup lets the user test whether round-robin plus multiple agents plus inter-agent messaging speeds up thinking and execution and improves robustness and correctness.
Decentralised microservices coordinating only through a Postgres queue (CNPG), with the orchestrator calling the Kubernetes API itself.
Integration with claude-code-wrapper is verified against the real wrapper, not only a fake.
Delivered as a new component code/agent-orchestrator with public GitHub origin szymonrychu/agent-orchestrator, CI, both images pushed to Harbor, least-privilege RBAC and a kind end-to-end test.
